name: Dagger Hills
summary: Bandits hold Dagger Hills, the rocky heights behind Moonbrook in southern Westfall. With royal patrols gone, the ridge threatens travelers and the plains below.

sections.title: A Bandit Haven
sections.body: The Defias Brotherhood uses this dry highland as a stronghold. Knuckledusters, pathstalkers and highwaymen hide among the crests and scrub. They ambush unwary travelers and watch the approaches to their strongholds below, keeping the surrounding plains under threat.

sections.title: Shadows on the Ridge
sections.body: Darkness brings danger to Dagger Hills. After sunset, Leprithus, a wandering ghoul, has been seen stalking the desolate heights. Outlaws and lingering undead roam the ridge. Nearby, Grimbooze Thunderbrew, a dwarven brewer, sets up his distilling equipment despite the dangers.

faq.q: Where are the Dagger Hills located?
aliases: how to get to dagger hills
faq.answer: Dagger Hills forms Westfall’s rocky southern border, directly behind Moonbrook.
The Defias Brotherhood holds much of the ridge. Highwaymen, pathstalkers and knuckledusters guard the southern hills.

faq.q: Why is a dwarf brewing ale out here?
faq.answer: Grimbooze Thunderbrew distills potent dwarven brews in the lonely heights, braving bandits and beasts for good drink.
Leprithus is an infamous ghoul roaming the Dagger Hills crags. It frightens travelers and bandits who meet it in the dark.

angles.text: The hills show how law has broken down in southern Westfall. Gryan Stoutmantle’s People’s Militia must fight to reclaim ground Stormwind left behind.
As a dwarf, you can see Grimbooze Thunderbrew’s solitary presence on this exposed ridge. Brewers seek undisturbed space for their craft with stubborn resolve.
